title: escalation
description: The product owner's ruling on a bead that used up its review rounds without approval. Pick exactly one outcome and fill the field that goes with it.

type.description: Omit this. The orchestrator stamps it when it stores the message.

outcome.description: approve_with_notes: ship it as it stands and record what is left. narrow_scope: replace the acceptance criteria with something achievable and review again. block: hand the bead to a human.

notes.description: What remains unaddressed. Required for approve_with_notes.

new_acceptance.description: The acceptance criteria that replace the bead's. Required for narrow_scope.

summary.description: What the human needs to know to take over: what was tried, where it stalled, what you recommend. Required for block.
